verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover creating a database with an indexing schema, describe insertion as "quick and intuitive" (with `insertMultiple` for bulk loads), and the GitHub README lists full-text search and simple browser/Deno imports. That supports the create-insert-search flow, but nothing shows a quickstart that reaches a first search within minutes. missing for 10: a documented end-to-end quickstart with a first-search example, evidence of time-to-first-search in minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding speed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create an index, add documents, and run my first search within minutes of starting the quickstart
